===== owners.GET.yml =====
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"
service:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ListOwners
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

===== owners.POST.yml =====
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate before Build so a missing or blank field is a 400 naming the offending
# fields, and the body is read (and republished) exactly once here.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Reject a create whose derived identityKey (normalizedTelephone|email|householdId) exactly
# matches an existing owner's, responding 409. This single key consolidates the former separate
# telephone, email and household duplicate checks.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

# Reject creating an owner when the request's city already contains 50 or more owners,
# responding 409.
ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyCreateLimit

# Reject creating an owner once 100 or more owners have already been created today
# (by registrationDate), responding 429.
ensureDailyCreateLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyCreateLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

# Assign the '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' customerCode before Save so the new owner is not yet
# counted: NNNN is one more than the current number of owners.
assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Group genuine housemates (same lastName + address, admitted via 'sharesHousehold')
# under one stable shared householdId, back-filling any existing members.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Count existing owners (before this create) sharing the same firstName + lastName
# (case-insensitive) and record it as namesakeCount before Save.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT log line carrying the owner id, customerCode and registrationDate.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: warn

# Flag whether more than 80 owners were created for this owner's registration day. Runs
# after Save so the new owner is counted, matching what a later GET recomputes.
warn:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: householdSize

# Record the owner's household size (owners sharing its householdId, including itself).
# Runs after Save so the new owner is counted, driving the 'GOLD' tier (3+ members) and
# matching what a later GET recomputes.
householdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

===== owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml =====
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

load:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.LoadOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]
  next: warn

# Flag whether more than 80 owners were created for this owner's registration day.
warn:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]
  next: householdSize

# Record the owner's household size (owners sharing its householdId, including itself),

respond:

1	## OfficeFloor REST endpoints
2	
3	Applies when adding or changing REST endpoints. This project serves REST through
4	OfficeFloor Function Injection, **not** Spring MVC controllers: each endpoint is a
5	pipeline of small function classes wired together in YAML.
6	
7	- Requires the OfficeFloor Spring Boot starter in the build:
8	  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` (Spring Boot 4.x) or
9	  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-3-starter` (Spring Boot 3.x). Without it these YAML
10	  files are inert. (Rules below track these starter versions.)
11	- Define each endpoint as a YAML file under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/`,
12	  named `<path>.<METHOD>.yml` (e.g. `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` → `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`).
13	- One small function class per step; compose steps with `next:` and `outputs:`.
14	- Do NOT generate `@RestController`, `@GetMapping` or `@PostMapping`.
15	- Transactions: `govern: [ transaction ]` on steps, not `@Transactional`.
16	- Errors: a handler YAML in `officefloor/escalation/`, not `@ControllerAdvice`.
17	
18	### Worked example — `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`
19	
20	The whole shape of an endpoint. The sections after this one are the reference.
21	
22	`src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`
23	
24	```yaml
25	# First step runs first. Validate before Load so an invalid body is a 400,
26	# not masked by a 404 for a missing owner.
27	validate:
28	  class: com.example.owner.ValidateOwner
29	  next: load
30	load:
31	  class: com.example.owner.LoadOwner
32	  next: apply
33	apply:
34	  class: com.example.owner.ApplyOwner
35	  govern: [ transaction ]
36	  next: save
37	save:
38	  class: com.example.owner.SaveOwner
39	  govern: [ transaction ]
40	  next: respond
41	respond:
42	  class: com.example.owner.RespondWithOwner
43	```
44	
45	```java
46	// One public method each. State moves by Out<T> (set) → @Val (read), matched by type.
47	public class ValidateOwner {
48	  public void validate(@RequestBody @Valid OwnerRequest request, Out<OwnerRequest> body) {
49	    body.set(request); // body read once here; republished for later steps
50	  }
51	}
52	public class LoadOwner {
53	  public void load(@PathVariable("ownerId") int ownerId, OwnerRepository repository,
54	      Out<Owner> ownerOut) throws OwnerNotFoundException {
55	    Owner owner = repository.findById(ownerId);
56	    if (owner == null) throw new OwnerNotFoundException(ownerId); // handled below
57	    ownerOut.set(owner);
58	  }
59	}
60	public class ApplyOwner { // @Val yields the stored object, not a copy — mutate in place
61	  public void apply(@Val OwnerRequest request, @Val Owner owner) {
62	    owner.setFirstName(request.firstName());
63	    owner.setLastName(request.lastName());
64	  }
65	}
66	public class SaveOwner {
67	  public void save(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository repository) {
68	    repository.save(owner);
69	  }
70	}
71	public class RespondWithOwner {
72	  public void respond(@Val Owner owner, ObjectResponse<OwnerResponse> response) {
73	    response.send(OwnerResponse.from(owner)); // this step responds; 200 by default
74	  }
75	}
76	```
77	
78	`src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/com.example.owner.OwnerNotFoundException.yml`
79	
80	```yaml
81	handle:
82	  class: com.example.owner.HandleOwnerNotFound
83	```
84	
85	```java
86	public class HandleOwnerNotFound {
87	  public void handle(@Parameter OwnerNotFoundException ex,
88	      ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<String>> response) {
89	    response.send(new ResponseEntity<>(ex.getMessage(), HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));
90	  }
91	}
92	```
93	
94	### Step wiring
95	
96	Each top-level YAML entry is a developer-chosen step name; the first is the entry
97	point. `class:` names the function. **Give each function class exactly one public
98	method** — several public methods fail at start-up unless every reference adds
99	`method:`.
100	
101	- `next: <step>` — run that step afterwards. This step's return value arrives there
102	  as `@Parameter T`.
103	- `outputs: { <name>: <step> }` — conditional branches. Declare a
104	  `@FunctionalInterface` parameter annotated `@Flow("<name>")` and call it to take the
105	  branch; not calling it short-circuits.
106	
107	### Function parameters
108	
109	Declare only what the step needs; they resolve by role:
110	
111	- `@PathVariable`, `@RequestParam`, `@RequestBody` — Spring MVC annotations work.
112	- Spring beans (repositories, mappers, services) — injected by type as normal.
113	- `ObjectResponse<T>` (`net.officefloor.web.ObjectResponse`) — send the response with
114	  `response.send(dto)`. This is how a step responds; wrap as
115	  `ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<T>>` to set status explicitly.
116	- `@Parameter T` (`net.officefloor.plugin.section.clazz.Parameter`) — the previous
117	  step's return value, a `@Flow` argument, or a thrown escalation.
118	
119	### Passing state between steps — `Out<T>` / `@Val`
120	
121	Steps do not call each other. Beyond the single `@Parameter` hand-off, publish state
122	into a variable (`net.officefloor.plugin.variable`):
123	
124	- Producer declares `Out<T>` and calls `set(...)`; consumer declares `@Val T`.
125	- Matching is **by type** — two variables of the same type in one pipeline need a
126	  `@Qualifier` annotation to disambiguate.
127	- `@Val` yields the same object the producer stored, **not a copy** — so an `Apply`
128	  step mutates the entity in place and later steps see the change.
129	
130	### Naming
131	
132	Verb plus entity: `Load<E>` (fetch by path variable, publishes `Out<E>`, throws when
133	absent) · `Build<E>` (construct from body) · `Validate<E>` (bind and validate the body,
134	publish it) · `Apply<E>` (mutate) · `Save<E>` · `Delete<E>` · `RespondWith<E>` (200) ·
135	`RespondWith<E>Created` (201) · `RespondWithNoContent` (204).
136	
137	Keep DTOs at the edges — request body in at the first step, response DTO out at the
138	responder. Steps in between work with entities.
139	
140	### Request body and validation
141	
142	- The HTTP body can be read only once: **only one step per pipeline may bind
143	  `@RequestBody`**. A second binding fails at runtime. When later steps need it, the
144	  first step publishes it as a variable.
145	- `@Valid` runs before that step's method body, so step order decides when validation
146	  happens. Put the validating step first — otherwise a missing id returns 404 before an
147	  invalid body can return 400.
148	
149	### Transactions
150	
151	`govern: [ transaction ]` for writes, `govern: [ readonly-transaction ]` for reads,
152	listed on **every** step it covers. Both are provided by the starter. Governance spans
153	the pipeline, so the request commits once at the end.
154	
155	### Errors
156	
157	Functions throw; handlers respond. The exception must be **checked** (`extends
158	Exception`) so it appears in the `throws` clause. Put the handler in
159	`officefloor/escalation/<fully.qualified.ExceptionClass>.yml`, taking the exception as
160	`@Parameter` and responding via `ObjectResponse`. Matching is most-specific-first;
161	anything unmatched falls through to Spring `@RestControllerAdvice`.
162	
163	### Security
164	
165	Guard a whole endpoint file with a Spring Security SpEL expression:
166	
167	```yaml
168	composition:
169	  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"
170	```
171	
172	- Full reference: https://officefloor.net/llms.txt

## 1. Owner JPA Entity

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`**

`@Entity @Table(name = "owners")`, extends `Person`. Fields (all `jakarta.persistence`/`jakarta.validation`):
- `address` — `@Column @NotEmpty String`
- `city` — `@Column @NotEmpty String` (a plain String, **not** a relation — see §5)
- `telephone` — `@Column @NotEmpty @Pattern(regexp = "^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$", message = "Phone number must be in E.164 form") String`
- `email` — `@Column String` (no constraint annotation)
- `registrationDate` — `@Column(name="registration_date") LocalDate`
- `customerCode` — `@Column(name="customer_code") String`
- `householdId` — `@Column(name="household_id") String`
- `namesakeCount` — `@Column(name="namesake_count") Integer`
- `bulkSignupWarning` — `@Transient Boolean` (derived at response time, never persisted; true when >80 owners share the registration day)
- `householdSize` — `@Transient Integer` (derived; count sharing householdId incl. self; drives GOLD tier at 3+)
- `pets` — `@OneToMany(cascade=ALL, mappedBy="owner", fetch=EAGER) Set<Pet>`; exposed via sorted unmodifiable `getPets()`, plus `addPet`, `getPet(name)`, `getPet(petId)`.

Base classes:
- **`Person.java`** (`@MappedSuperclass`): `firstName`, `lastName` both `@Column @NotEmpty protected String`.
- **`BaseEntity.java`** (`@MappedSuperclass`): `id` — `@Id @GeneratedValue(strategy=IDENTITY) protected Integer`; plus `@JsonIgnore isNew()`.

---

## 2. DTOs (generated, not on disk)

No `*Dto.java` files exist in source. The Maven `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` (pom.xml lines 369–411) generates them into `target/generated-sources/openapi/...` at build:
- `generatorName: spring`, `interfaceOnly: true`, `modelNameSuffix: Dto`
- `modelPackage: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`
- `apiPackage: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api`
- `performBeanValidation: true`, `useJakartaEe: true`, `serializationLibrary: jackson`

Owner DTO classes referenced in code: **`OwnerFieldsDto`** (editable request fields), **`OwnerDto`** (full response incl. `OwnerDto.ContactPreferenceEnum{EMAIL,PHONE}`), **`OwnerPageDto`** (paged). Their shape is defined in the OpenAPI schemas below.

**Schemas in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** (lines 1991–2202):

- `OwnerFields` (→ `OwnerFieldsDto`): `firstName` (1–30, letters pattern), `lastName` (1–30, letters pattern w/ optional trailing dot), `address` (1–255), `city` (1–80), `telephone` (1–20, pattern `^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$`, stored/returned E.164), `email` (format email, 1–255, lower-cased), `registrationDate` (date, defaults to server date), `sharesHousehold` (boolean, `writeOnly`). **Required: firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone.**
- `Owner` (→ `OwnerDto`): `allOf` OwnerFields + readOnly derived: `id`, `displayName` ("Last, First"), `initials` ("G.F."), `customerCode` (`<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`), `membershipNumber` (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`), `householdId`, `identityKey` (`normalizedTelephone|email|householdId`), `namesakeCount`, `membershipLevel` (1–3), `locality` (region), `bulkSignupWarning`, `contactPreference` (enum EMAIL/PHONE), `pets` (required array).
- `OwnerPage` (→ `OwnerPageDto`): `content[]`, `page`, `size`, `totalElements` (int64), `totalPages`.

**Mapper: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — MapStruct `@Mapper(uses = PetMapper.class)`. Maps `toOwnerDto` with `@Mapping` expressions computing `displayName`, `initials`, `membershipNumber`, `membershipLevel` (via `MembershipLevels.of`), `locality` (via `Localities.region`), `contactPreference`, `identityKey` (via `OwnerIdentityKey.of`). Also `toOwner(OwnerDto)`, `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` (ignores id/pets), collection maps, and a default `toOwnerPageDto(Page<Owner>)`.

## 3. Owner REST YAML files

Under **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/`**:

| Path | Endpoint | Pipeline (step → class) |

## 4. Owner function classes

Package **`org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner`** at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. All use `@Val`/`Out<T>` variable passing, `@RequestBody`/`@PathVariable`/`@RequestParam` binding, `ObjectResponse<T>` for responses.

**Validate:**
- `ValidateOwnerFields` — POST. Normalizes address (`OwnerAddress.normalize`), checks firstName/lastName/address/city/telephone non-blank → `MissingOwnerFieldsException`; converts telephone to E.164 (`OwnerTelephone.toE164`) → `InvalidOwnerTelephoneException`; `OwnerEmail.normalize` → `InvalidOwnerEmailException`; publishes `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>`.

**Build / Apply / Save / Load / Delete:**
- `BuildOwner` — `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` + `OwnerMapper` → `Owner`; sets registrationDate to `BusinessDays.adjust(supplied-or-now)`.
- `ApplyOwner` — mutates loaded `Owner` in place from request (address, city, firstName, lastName, telephone, email).
- `SaveOwner` — `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.
- `LoadOwner` — `@PathVariable ownerId` → `Lookups.findOrNotFound(...)` throws `NotFoundException`.

- `RespondWithOwnerCreated` — 201, `ResponseEntity.created(URI /api/owners/{id})`.

## 5. City

## 4. Owner function classes

Package **`org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner`** at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. All use `@Val`/`Out<T>` variable passing, `@RequestBody`/`@PathVariable`/`@RequestParam` binding, `ObjectResponse<T>` for responses.

**Validate:**
- `ValidateOwnerFields` — POST. Normalizes address (`OwnerAddress.normalize`), checks firstName/lastName/address/city/telephone non-blank → `MissingOwnerFieldsException`; converts telephone to E.164 (`OwnerTelephone.toE164`) → `InvalidOwnerTelephoneException`; `OwnerEmail.normalize` → `InvalidOwnerEmailException`; publishes `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>`.
- `ValidateOwner` — PUT. `@Validated`, `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto`; `OwnerEmail.normalize`; publishes. Runs before Load so invalid body = 400 even if owner missing.

**Build / Apply / Save / Load / Delete:**
- `BuildOwner` — `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` + `OwnerMapper` → `Owner`; sets registrationDate to `BusinessDays.adjust(supplied-or-now)`.
- `ApplyOwner` — mutates loaded `Owner` in place from request (address, city, firstName, lastName, telephone, email).
- `SaveOwner` — `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.
- `LoadOwner` — `@PathVariable ownerId` → `Lookups.findOrNotFound(...)` throws `NotFoundException`.
- `DeleteOwner` — `ownerRepository.delete(owner)`. (Note: DELETE is a hard delete — no soft-delete despite test-harness comments.)

**RespondWith:**
- `RespondWithOwner` — 200, `OwnerDto`.
- `RespondWithOwnerCreated` — 201, `ResponseEntity.created(URI /api/owners/{id})`.
- `RespondWithOwnerUpdated` — sends `ResponseEntity.status(NO_CONTENT).body(dto)`.

**List:**
- `ListOwners` — optional `lastName` param; `findByLastName`/`findAll`; 404 if empty else 200 list.
- `ListOwnersPage` — `lastName`/`page`/`size` params; `PageRequest` (default size 20, `Sort.by("id")`); returns `OwnerPageDto`.

**Ensure (create guards):**
- `EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity` — builds `OwnerIdentityKey` (resolves household first), 409 `DuplicateOwnerIdentityException` on full-key match.
- `EnsureCityCapacity` — `CAPACITY = 50` per city; 409 `CityAtCapacityException`.
- `EnsureDailyCreateLimit` — `DAILY_LIMIT = 100` per business day; 429 `DailyCreateLimitException`.

**Assign (create enrichment):**
- `AssignOwnerCustomerCode` — `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`, NNNN = existing-in-city + 1.
- `AssignOwnerHousehold` — groups same normalized lastName+address under shared `householdId` (SHA-256 derived), back-fills existing members.
- `AssignOwnerHouseholdSize` — transient size (count sharing householdId, incl self; solo = 1).
- `AssignOwnerNamesakeCount` — count existing owners with same first+last (case-insensitive), excluding self.
- `AssignOwnerBulkSignupWarning` — `BULK_SIGNUP_THRESHOLD = 80`; sets flag when count for the day exceeds it.
- `AuditOwnerCreated` — logs to `"AUDIT"` SLF4J logger (id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel).

**Pet-scoped owner functions:** `BuildOwnersPet` (`PetFieldsDto`→`Pet`, sets owner), `LoadOwnersPet` (ownership-scoped, throws `NotFoundException` if pet not this owner's).

**Helper/utility classes (package-private except OwnerIdentityKey):**
- `OwnerAddress` — trim/collapse/upper-case + expand ST→STREET, RD→ROAD, AVE→AVENUE; idempotent.
- `OwnerEmail` — regex `^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$`, lower-cases in place, throws `InvalidOwnerEmailException`.
- `OwnerTelephone` — E.164 normalization; default country code `61`; national-length map (`61`→9, `1`→10); 8–15 digits; `toE164`/`canonical`.
- `OwnerHousehold` — `resolve`, `id` (SHA-256 → 12 upper-hex chars), `normalizeName`, `normalizeAddress` (delegates to `OwnerAddress`).
- `OwnerIdentityKey` (public) — `tel|email|householdId`; `of(Owner)` and `of(tel,email,household)`.

**Common helpers** at `.../rest/function/common/`:
- `BusinessDays.adjust` — rolls weekends forward to Monday (does NOT skip holidays, unlike the test harness's version).
- `MembershipLevels.of` — level 1, +1 email, +1 namesakeCount==0, capped at `MAX_LEVEL=3`.
- `Localities.region` — fixed map Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD, else `UNKNOWN`.
- `Lookups.findOrNotFound` — translates `ObjectRetrievalFailureException`/`EmptyResultDataAccessException`/null → `NotFoundException`.
- `RespondWithNoContent` — 204 responder.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name and address (i.e. they share a household). Request-only override; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of owners already in that city when the owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the owner's customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners that share a household (the same last name and address). Assigned when an owner joins an existing household via the 'sharesHousehold' request flag; absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email is empty when absent, the householdId is empty when the owner shares no household). Creation is rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3, assigned on creation. Starts at 1, gains 1 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, and is capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city via a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners share this owner's registration date (i.e. more than 80 owners were created for that business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

I added an optional `postcode` field to the owner, validated only when present, following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions.

**Contract & persistence**
- `openapi.yml` — added `postcode` to the `OwnerFields` schema (4-digit string; `Owner` inherits it via `allOf`, so it's stored and returned). Not in `required`, keeping the request backward-compatible.
